effects.name: generated-workflow-read
effects.source: the project's .github/workflows/vouch.yml, read by check when a project root is given and the store holds init's config.json
effects.capture: its file type and bytes, compared with the workflow the running Vouch generates

effects.name: generated-workflow-write
effects.detail: refresh-workflow writes .github/workflows/vouch.yml with the running Vouch's generated workflow (mode 0644, through a temporary file and an atomic rename), creating missing directories; it writes nothing else and refuses symlinked paths and projects without .vouch/config.json
